evidence: grocery/out/test-auditors-fail-2026-09-26.txt:996-997 'test-auditors FAIL (1 failed, 790 passed)'; :410 the only FAIL 'script-census fires on the live tree'; :606 'WIDE RATCHET ROSE: 74 unrecorded orphan(s) outside grocery\, over the high-water mark of 73'

re-run 10:05 in the main checkout: audit-script-census rc=2, same 74 over 73. The 74 names (listed by a scratch copy that prints $wideNew; 109 uncalled, identical to the real run): the two newest are ops/verify-gate-declaration.ps1 (added 2026-09-26 9fe97ed8d) and ops/report-push-time.ps1 (2026-09-25 db2772297), both BY-HAND tools with no executable caller; and exactly one is untracked: sidecar/.venv/Scripts/activate.ps1 (gitignored by .gitignore:39, present only in the main checkout)

push ledger pushes-2026-09-26.jsonl 13:50Z..14:11Z: four 'hook-refused' rows, cause run-gates, gate grocery\audit-script-census.ps1, local_sha 8df33b9be, checkout C:\Codex\ThriftyCrew: the bot's push from the main checkout was refused by this gate while worktree pushes (663e2dd5c 06:35, d6aedc2f3 07:07) landed, because a worktree has no sidecar\.venv and read the wide tier one lower

surface_fix.what: record the two by-hand scripts in KNOWN with their reasons, and tighten the wide mark to what the census now reads

items.root_cause: the census's population is 'every .ps1 on disk under the repo', so it includes gitignored vendored files (a Python venv's activate script) that exist in the main checkout and in no worktree; the wide mark was set and is re-checked by pushes from worktrees, so the main checkout, which is where the bot pushes from and where the daily test-auditors runs, reads one over the mark and any single new by-hand script tips it red there only. And a rise names no script, so every fixer has to rebuild the census to find the newcomer.

root_fix.what: prune vendored environment directories (.venv, venv, node_modules) from the census population wherever they sit, on the path below the root, prune and filter both; and make a wide-tier rise list every unrecorded wide orphan by name
root_fix.exact_change: $VendoredDirs = '(^|\\)(\.venv|venv|node_modules)\\'; Get-TcTreeFiles -PruneBelow ('\\archive\\|' + $VendoredDirs) and a Where-Object on Get-TcPathBelowRoot; after the WIDE RATCHET ROSE finding, one 'wide-unrecorded <path>' line per $wideNew entry

prevention.what: the emitting check measures the same population in every checkout, so a mark set from a worktree holds in the main checkout, and a rise names its scripts

blast_radius.measured_by: live census in the main checkout before and after: 109 -> 108 uncalled, wide unrecorded 74 -> 71 (the venv script pruned, the two by-hand scripts recorded); no pricing or matching code touched
blast_radius.risk: a repo script inside a directory named venv or node_modules would stop being censused; there is none today (the only such path found was the untracked venv script)
